issues.title: Legacy REPL call path conflicts with the typed function contract
issues.detail: The existing REPL still documents dbg call and TriggerExecuteByName even though the formal Kernel only accepts allowlisted operations.
issues.resolution: Stage 16 exposes only explicit registry-backed invoke in the REPL, and the live ping returned OK through the Bank transport.

issues.title: Galaxy key=value parser included operation delimiters
issues.detail: The inclusive StringSub end index included the semicolon after operation and request_id values.
issues.resolution: All three controlled kernel mirrors now exclude the delimiter; the runtime Bank response uses the original request_id and operation=function.invoke.

issues.title: Registered legacy parser retains known catalog/native warnings
issues.detail: The existing cross-file parser warnings are unrelated to the explicit function registry and remain outside this stage scope.
issues.resolution: Recorded for the next parser-hardening stage; no source repository changes made.
